_why: The names a GenerationSpec may use for ace-step-1.5-turbo, flattened the way ModelProfile::flat_inputs does it -- group members dotted. Pinned from BOTH sides: a Rust test asserts flat_inputs() produces exactly this, and a frontend test asserts panelModel() produces exactly this minus the unsupported entries. Neither side could see the other before, and they disagreed for four tasks: the panel flattened `planner.cfg_scale` to `cfg_scale`, so every ACE-Step generation was rejected with "has no input named cfg_scale" while both sides' own tests passed.
